encoding_notes: SOURCE: live HTML guide (journals.sagepub.com/author-instructions/OJS) Cloudflare-blocked (403 on WebFetch AND Apify headless render, 0 pages scraped). Encoded from SAGE's current official PDF mirror at www.sagepub.com/docs/.../submission-guidelines_-orthopaedic-journal-of-sports-medicine_-sage-journals.pdf?sfvrsn=d081593b_4 (HTTP 200), extracted via pypdf. Full clean current content (page footers dated 4/30/26) — treat as TIER_A content obtained via the sagepub.com PDF mirror rather than a shell/archive.

Article-type mapping from the guide's 'Study Designs' list: Meta-analysis + Systematic Review -> systematic_review; Randomized Controlled Clinical Trial, Crossover Study Design, Cohort Study, Case-Control Study, Cross-Sectional Study, Descriptive Epidemiology Study, Controlled Laboratory Study, Descriptive Laboratory Study -> original_research; Case Series -> case_series; Case Report -> case_report; Letters to the Editor -> letter. No narrative/general review, technical note, or (author-submitted) editorial type is offered, so 'review', 'narrative_review', 'technical_note', and 'editorial' were omitted. (Supplementary videos are encouraged for surgical/technique manuscripts but are an attachment, not a standalone article type.)

Blinding: 'OJSM utilizes a double-anonymized peer-review process for new submissions' -> double_blind=true. Required-on-submission items are (1) a separate 'Title page including the information found on the journal title page template' AND (2) 'The anonymized manuscript' -> separate_title_page=true. 'No identifying information should appear in the uploaded manuscript. Please remove author names, initials, and institutions. State or country names may be used, but do not include specific locations such as cities or regions' -> scrub_body_identifiers=true; scrub_metadata=true (double-anonymized requirement; institution 'should not be mentioned in the anonymized manuscript, but should be added on acceptance'). Photo de-id: identifiable patient photos need a signed release, else 'the patient's eyes must be occluded.'

Layout: 'Manuscript pages should be double-spaced with consecutive page numbers and continuous line numbers' -> line_spacing=double, page_numbers.show=true, line_numbers=continuous (EXPLICIT, high confidence). page_size, font family/size, margins, alignment, first_line_indent, running_head, headings all UNSTATED -> null/false. Body order: 'In general, follow the standard IMRAD (Introduction, Methods, Results, Discussion) format for writing scientific articles' -> sections.original_research=[Introduction, Methods, Results, Discussion]; not encoded for other types because the guide only names IMRAD generically for scientific articles.

Title page: elements=[] because the enumerated element list lives in a separate 'journal title page template' file not reachable in this text; the guide states 'The Title page including the information found on the journal title page template' and separately 'Acknowledgments should be placed on the title page submitted for review' (so acknowledgments is a known title-page element, but the full ordered set is not encodable). running_title/title length caps and authors_degrees all unstated -> null.

Abstract: 'Abstracts should summarize the contents of the article in 350 words or less' -> max_words=350. 'The abstract should be structured in the following format' -> structured=true; sections encode the guide's headings Background / Hypothesis/Purpose / Study Design / Methods / Results / Conclusion / Clinical Relevance. TWO trailing reviewer-only items ('What is known about the subject' and 'What this study adds to existing knowledge') are excluded from sections — the guide states they 'are for reviewers only and are not included in the word count.' Case reports are exempt: 'The abstract should be included with the manuscript... except for case reports, which do not require abstracts' -> case_report abstract_max_words=null.
Keywords: 'Key Terms: Provide at least 4 key words for indexing' -> required=true, min=4, max=null (no upper bound stated). case/separator unstated -> null.

Word limits: 'There are no limitations on figures, tables, and references' -> references_min/max, figures_max, tables_max all null (unlimited) for every type. NO manuscript word cap is stated for any type -> manuscript_max_words=null throughout. abstract_max_words=350 for original_research/systematic_review/case_series; null for case_report (no abstract required) and letter (no abstract). Reports on surgery 'require a minimum follow-up of 2 years' (content rule, not a length cap).

References: style=ama ('use ... the AMA Manual of Style (11th ed) for format'). order=alphabetical is STRONGLY enforced: 'References should be double-spaced in alphabetical order by the last name of the first author and numbered according to alphabetical listing. If references are not in alphabetical order the uploaded file will be REJECTED.' journal_abbrev=nlm ('use the Index Medicus form for abbreviating journal titles'). in_text=null: the guide never states the in-text marker format (AMA convention is superscript, but no explicit instruction/example is given — left null per accuracy-first). include_doi=false and et_al_threshold=null: both unstated in the guide. max_count=null (references are unlimited).

Tables: 'The anonymized manuscript including the abstract and any tables and figures where they occur in the text' -> placement=in_text. 'Tables should be numbered consecutively and have a title that describes the content' -> numbering=arabic; caption_position=null (a title is required but above/below not specified). System accepts most common word-processing formats; Word/Excel tables preferred.

Figures: separate_files=true — 'If figures are embedded in the submitted manuscript for ease of reading, they should also be submitted as separate files for use in the publication process' (and photos embedded in Word/PowerPoint are 'not acceptable for publication'). legends_location=in_text — 'Be sure to include figure legends in the text.' SCHEMA GAP tiered DPI: 'Files for line-based drawings ... should be 1200 dots per inch (dpi). Color photos should be submitted at 600 dpi and black-and-white photos at 300 dpi' -> min_dpi=300 encoded as the floor; the 600 (color) and 1200 (line art) tiers are not representable. formats=[]: the guide does NOT enumerate accepted figure file formats (only DPI + 'original form created, e.g., Word, Excel, or PowerPoint' for charts). callout_style and naming_pattern unstated -> null. Color is unlimited/free in the Journal.

Declarations: order=[] and required=null because the guide prescribes no ordered in-manuscript declarations block. Compliance items are handled as separate uploaded forms / conditional statements: the OJSM Author Disclosure Statement (conflict of interest) is required for ALL submissions (incl. letters) and is uploaded as a Word file using the 'conflict of interest' file type, checked against the CMS Open Payments Database for combined payments >$500/yr over the prior 5 years; IRB/ethics approval (or waiver) letter is required when human/animal subjects/tissues/health information are used, with an in-text approval statement + enrollment date range; a signed patient permission letter is required for case reports and identifiable photos; clinical-trial registration is required for trials started after Jan 1 2016 (CONSORT flow diagram + checklist for RCTs; STROBE for observational; MIBO for biologics; ARRIVE for animal studies); AI use 'must' be declared if applicable, naming the program and how it was used. Acknowledgments go on the title page.

Misc: orcid_required=false ('We strongly encourage all authors ... to link their ORCID ID' — encouraged, not mandated). cover_letter_required=false ('Cover letter, acknowledgments, and suggested reviewers are optional'), though conditionally required for >5 authors ('If a paper has more than 5 authors, a cover letter detailing the contributions of all authors should be included'). highlights_required=null (unmentioned). title_case=null (no article-title capitalization rule). No submission fees; APCs assessed only on acceptance, tiered $330–$1700 by World Bank income group / society membership / cascade (submissions on/after Jan 1 2026). License: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-nd/4.0/). Use metric units; actual P values unless <.001; 95% CIs encouraged. ISSN=null: not stated in the guide text (not encoded from memory).
[schema-required default] references.in_text defaulted to 'superscript' (guide did not state the in-text citation marker; schema requires a value; inferred from reference style 'ama').
